phrase.en: The system has crashed twice recently.
phrase.ru: В последнее время система упала дважды.
phrase.es: El sistema se ha caído dos veces últimamente.

text.ru: recently, twice, this week — период ещё не закончился, поэтому Present Perfect: It has crashed twice this week. Конкретное время в прошлом — Past Simple: It crashed yesterday.
text.en: recently, twice, this week — the period isn’t over, so use the Present Perfect: It has crashed twice this week. A finished time — Past Simple: It crashed yesterday.
text.es: recently, twice, this week: Present Perfect. Un momento pasado concreto: Past Simple — It crashed yesterday.

examples.en: The app crashed yesterday at noon.
We've recently moved to a new system.
examples.ru: Недавно мы перешли на новую систему.

exercises.en: We've had a lot of bugs ___.
exercises.ru: В последнее время у нас много багов.

exercises.en: The system has crashed twice this week.
